subject.title: fix(compaction): prevent repeated restarts after safety timeouts

question: After the shared timeout contract is repaired, should OpenClaw accept explicitly marked native compaction results produced immediately after safety-timeout cancellation while the exact timeout-owned settlement token remains open?
rationale: Code review can verify the bounded mechanics, but changing aborted compaction from always fail-closed to conditionally state-committing requires an explicit session-state policy decision.

options.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
options.body: Keep the exact-timeout settlement window after restoring the shared helper and confirming current-head checks.

options.title: Keep timeout fail-closed
options.body: Retain inner chunk partial-summary recovery and timeout guidance but remove the post-abort AgentSession commit path.

options.title: Require realistic live proof
options.body: Pause acceptance until a slow-provider or full gateway run demonstrates recovery without late or duplicate session mutations.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
recommendation.body: Keep the exact-timeout settlement window after restoring the shared helper and confirming current-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to vincentkoc and recent compaction-timeout history makes him the clearest available owner for this session-state policy choice.
